concerns.licence: GPL-2.0-only WITH libgit2 linking exception; xdiff LGPL-2.1-or-later
concerns.requires: libgit2 itself: GPL-2.0 with its linking exception, so linking it unchanged into paw needs only this notice; changes to libgit2's own files would fall under the GPL. Its bundled xdiff (deps/xdiff, compiled in) is LGPL-2.1-or-later: static linking in an iOS app means offering what lets someone relink paw with a changed xdiff (paw's object files or its source, which is public), plus the LGPL text. The LGPL's terms on redistribution sit badly with App Store terms; decide before listing. PCRE2 (BSD-3-Clause), llhttp and sha1dc (MIT) are permissive. Source: https://github.com/libgit2/libgit2.
